enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Resistance +11: Passive: +11 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Acid Absorption +36%: Passive: 36% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Fortification +149%: +149% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Legendary Temple's Monolith: 2 Pieces Equipped:+15 Artifact Bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+30 Artifact Bonus to Acid Spell Power+30 Artifact Bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
